fields.PRODUCT NAME: Eternal Love – Radha Krishna Marble Painting (Framed)
fields.DESCRIPTION: Celebrate the divine essence of love and devotion with this stunning Eternal Love – Radha Krishna Marble Painting, handcrafted in the heart of Rajasthan. This artwork captures the tender embrace of Lord Krishna and Radha, symbolizing eternal love, harmony, and spiritual union. The finely detailed expressions, traditional attire, and the presence of a peacock create a serene and romantic ambiance.
